name: Remoraid
description: Spits water from its mouth with incredible accuracy. It captures Burmy by shooting them down off the branches from which they dangle.

moves.name: Bubble
moves.description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

moves.name: Acid Spray
moves.description: The user spits fluid that works to melt the target. This may also lower the target’s defensive stats.

moves.name: Charge Beam
moves.description: The user attacks the target with an electric charge. The leftover electricity may also raise the user’s offensive stats.

moves.name: Water Pulse
moves.description: The user attacks the target with a pulsing blast of water. This attack never misses.

moves.name: Ice Beam
moves.description: The target is struck with an icy-cold beam of energy. This may also leave the target with frostbite.

moves.name: Hydro Pump
moves.description: The target is blasted by a huge volume of water launched under great pressure.

moves.name: Hyper Beam
moves.description: The target is attacked with a powerful beam.
